svg.text: Your factory business: take contracts, buy equipment, grow
You own a small factory. Contracts pay; you choose which to take. Money buys robots, better machines, then whole lines. The investor wants his cut.
Pick what you can handle. Your difficulty, your call.
due in 3 shifts · needs a paint machine
